title: Find is fragmented: Ctrl+F always targets the output pane, the find bar is permanently dark, the run-output viewer reimplements search, and the script editor has no find at all
existing_state: Form1.ProcessCmdKey intercepts Ctrl+F app-wide and always opens the output find anchored to txtOutput (Form1.cs:14462-14464, 14482-14492); the find logic is hardwired to txtOutput (seeds from txtOutput.SelectedText at 14484, match/cursor logic at 14516, 14549), and F3/Shift+F3 are likewise always captured for output-pane navigation (14472-14477). The Scintilla script editor has no find/replace capability of any kind (no search code in UI/ScintillaScriptEditorControl.cs beyond an indentation helper) — so a user editing a multi-hundred-line YAML preset who presses Ctrl+F gets focus yanked to a dialog searching the wrong pane, and has no way to locate a variable or step name in the script. The find bar itself (FindDialog) hardcodes a VS Code dark palette as static colors and never touches DialogTheme (FindDialog.cs:9-19, 38-50) — in light mode it renders as a floating dark rectangle over a white app. RunOutputViewerDialog implements the same find-in-output concept from scratch with a divergent interaction: a toggled docked panel, Enter/Shift+Enter only, no incremental search, no match counter, no case toggle (RunOutputViewerDialog.cs:69-135, 302-315). FindDialog also ships three constructed-but-hidden controls marked 'not implemented' (whole word, regex, find-in-selection — FindDialog.cs:115-131, 147-153).
recommendation: 1) Make FindDialog take a darkMode flag and map its static colors onto DialogTheme tokens. 2) Extract it into a reusable find-bar control and replace RunOutputViewerDialog's bespoke search panel with it so both output surfaces behave identically. 3) Route Ctrl+F/F3 by focus in ProcessCmdKey: when the script editor is focused, drive Scintilla's SearchInTarget/indicator API with the same bar (incremental highlight-all + Enter/Shift+Enter next/prev + Esc dismiss) instead of jumping to output. Delete or finish the hidden whole-word/regex toggles while in there.
user_benefit: One search muscle-memory everywhere: Ctrl+F finds in whatever you're looking at — including the YAML you're editing, which is currently unsearchable — looks correct in light mode, and the run-output viewer gains the match counter and case toggle the main window already has.

evidence.note: Ctrl+F/F3 unconditionally routed to output-pane find regardless of focused control
Find logic is hardwired to txtOutput
Hardcoded dark palette; no DialogTheme usage in file (verified by grep)
Second, divergent search implementation: toggle panel, Enter-only navigation, no counter/case toggle
Whole-word/regex/find-in-selection controls built then hidden 'not implemented'
Only 'Find' matches are an indentation helper — the editor has no user-facing find

mockup_idea: Three panels: (1) current light-mode app with the dark find bar floating on white, (2) current RunOutputViewerDialog search panel vs main find bar side-by-side, (3) the unified themed bar shown over both output and the script editor with match-count badge and highlighted matches in the YAML.
